column1: # Measured surface for the lifecycle-replay suite. See s7-false-completion/surface.tsv
# for why this is a content fingerprint and not a commit SHA.
# The deployed contract heads the list because it is what the session reads, and
# r2 grades one of its clauses verbatim. The hook scripts are listed too, which
# the traps' surfaces do not do: a replay run cannot suppress the machine's
# hooks without also losing the contract (measured 2026-08-12), so the hook
# layer is inside this construct rather than beside it.
